scope: AppKit overflow and action reachability through MixerGuestScreen with a test-signed ABI2/UI1 Arabic checklist

fixture.notes: Copy $RUN/vm/release/libmixer_vm.a to $RUN/lib/libmixer_vm_capability_experimental.a. Signed fixture uses test trust roots, public runtime ingress, and app-private test storage.

regression.baseline: Failed six assertions. No native scroll view in any case. Both 16-point cases had zero clickable rows.
regression.candidate: Passed all six cases. Each native click delivered exactly one activate event for toggle/task.toggle at revision 1. The guest checks exact packet bytes and shows its revision 3 completion only after committed storage success.
regression.cleanup: Each test window closed and its hosting view detached. Each signed fixture runtime retired before its temporary directory teardown.

limits: Native clip movement was driven through NSClipView before pointer delivery to the fixture NSWindow. Directly injected synthetic wheel events did not move the clip.

The optional positive native display observation test timed out on both baseline and candidate with AppKit occlusion state 8192, which lacks the visible bit. The detached/hidden negative check and the signed offscreen health check passed.
The run used two Dynamic Type environment settings without asserting macOS font growth or RTL text geometry. It did not qualify installed FieldLog, iOS Simulator, Android or either local gate.
